modmenu.summaryTranslation.autoominousbo: Drinks an Ominous Bottle after every raid. For AFK raid farms.
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.autoomino: Drinks an Ominous Bottle after every raid, eats when hungry, can jump until the raid starts and counts won raids. For AFK raid farms.
autoominousbottle.config.title: Auto Ominous Bottle
autoominousbottle.config.enabled.tip: Turn the whole mod on or off.
autoominousbottle.config.confirm_enable: Confirm the key with a second press
The key turns the mod on only with a second press within 3 seconds, so you don't drink a bottle in a village by accident. Turning off is always instant.
autoominousbottle.config.auto_disable: Turn off after rejoin, dimension change, death
autoominousbottle.config.auto_disable.ti: The mod is always off when you enter a world, change dimension or die.
autoominousbottle.config.low_health_disa: Turn the mod off and sound the alarm when health drops to the threshold.
autoominousbottle.config.exit_no_bottles: Leave the world when out of bottles
When the bottles run out after a raid, wait 10 seconds and leave the world.
autoominousbottle.config.keybind.tip: Opens the controls. The key is in the Auto Ominous Bottle section.
autoominousbottle.config.auto_drink: Drink an Ominous Bottle after a raid
autoominousbottle.config.auto_drink.tip: Drinks when there is no raid bar and no omen. Bottles are taken from the hotbar, then from the inventory.
autoominousbottle.config.drink_delay.tip: How long there must be no raid bar and no omen before drinking the next bottle.
autoominousbottle.config.stop_after_raid: Counted from the moment the mod is turned on.
autoominousbottle.config.stop_after_minu: Time with the mod on; game pauses are not counted.
autoominousbottle.config.auto_eat.tip: Eats food from the inventory. Rotten flesh, spider eyes, chorus fruit and golden apples are never eaten.
autoominousbottle.config.eat_below.tip: Eat when hunger drops to this value. A full bar is 20.
autoominousbottle.config.auto_jump.tip: Jump while you have an omen and the raid has not started yet. For farms where the raid will not start without jumping.
Status icon with raids, bottles and what the mod is doing.
Only the status icon, no text.
Simplified: one short line above the hotbar, no icon.
autoominousbottle.config.hud_when_off: Show when the mod is off
autoominousbottle.config.hud_when_off.ti: When the mod is off, the screen still shows its status.
autoominousbottle.config.animations.tip: Animated icons and the bottle animation. Off: icons stand still. Auto: off when Graphics is set to Fast.
autoominousbottle.config.sounds.tip: Every mod sound can be replaced with a resource pack: autoominousbottle:enable, disable, confirm, raid_won, warning, danger.
autoominousbottle.config.volume.tip: Volume of the mod's own sounds.
autoominousbottle.config.animation.tip: The Ominous Bottle looks around and smiles once, then disappears.
autoominousbottle.config.animation_on_dr: Play the animation every time the mod starts drinking a bottle.
autoominousbottle.pack.animated_item.des: The Ominous Bottle item looks around
subtitles.autoominousbottle.confirm: Auto Ominous Bottle waits for confirmation
autoominousbottle.msg.no_bottles_exit: Out of Ominous Bottles, leaving the world in 10 seconds
autoominousbottle.msg.drink_failed: The bottle gave no omen twice, auto-drink turned off (Peaceful difficulty?)
